name: Hridayesh
reason: Lord of the heart; correct hṛdaya + īśa, sound and used.

name: Indivar
reason: Blue lotus; Devanagari with anusvara and dropped final a agrees with indīvara.

name: Kamalakar
reason: Lotus-source/lotus pond, epithet of the sun; established name.

name: Manavendra
reason: IAST lacks long ā; Devanagari मानवेन्द्र and part mānava require mānavendra.

name: Naimish
reason: Naimiṣa, sacred forest of the Puranas, in use as a boy's name; meaning acceptable.

name: Pranesh
reason: prāṇa + īśa, lord of life; sound.

name: Radheshyam
reason: Form is vocative 'Radhe Shyam' (invocation), not 'Radha's Shyam'; common name, meaning corrected.

fix.meaning_en: Radha and Shyam (Krishna), an invocation of the divine pair.

name: Sharadchandra
reason: Sandhi: d before c becomes cc (śaraccandra); IAST and Devanagari corrected.

name: Siddheshwar
reason: Siddha + īśvara, Shiva epithet in common use; correct.

name: Tarakeshwar
reason: Meaning 'saviour mantra' is unsupported; tāraka is 'one who ferries across, saviour'.

fix.meaning_en: Lord who ferries across, the saviour; Shiva.

name: Mukteshwar
reason: mukta + īśvara, Shiva epithet used as a name; correct.
